name: 郭志宇
objective: This course introduces students of engineering to those areas of mathematics which are important in connection with practical engineering problems. The material in this course is arranged accordingly in four parts: (1) First-order, second-order, and higher-order differential equations. (2) Series solutions of differential equations and special functions. (3) Laplace transforms.

Week/Topic

2 First-order ODE
3 First-order ODE	
4 Second-order ODE	
5 Second-order ODE	
6 1st Midterm
7 Series solution of ODE		
8 Series solution of ODE	
9 Series solution of ODE	
10 Series solution of ODE	
11 Series solution of ODE	 	
12 2nd Midterm
13 Laplace transform 
14 Laplace transform 	
15 Laplace transform 	
16 Final Exam

類別

        內容
        
          採用預錄製課程之教材，請同學於彈性週進行線上學習，並可以持續複習至第二週，第二週結束有課程相關的習題作業需要繳交，彈性週作業占總成績 10%。
The course materials will be pre-recorded. Students are requested to study online during the flexible week and can continue to review until the second week. At the end of the second week, there will be course-related exercises to be submitted. The flexible week assessment score accounts for Bonus to the total score.
